root_cause_criterion.obligation: When the hash matches, `r1->hname_len == name_len` must hold before `pj_memcmp(r1->hname, name, name_len)` executes.
root_cause_criterion.description: After the colliding hash match, `compare_handler` must reject unequal header-name lengths before it reaches `pj_memcmp`. The vulnerable original lets the one-byte stored shortname `k` and the seven-byte token `TON+Vip` fall through to the byte compare.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `stored_name_len=1`, `incoming_name_len=7`, and a triggered `compare_handler_sink`; the fixed original records the same 1-vs-7 mismatch but no sink event; the fixed `adjacent_shortname_k` perturbation reaches `compare_handler_sink` with `stored_name_len=1` and `incoming_name_len=1`.

nodes.description: `pj_memcmp(r1->hname, name, name_len)` compares more bytes than were initialized in the stored shortname record, so the compare reads the uninitialized tail copied from `int_register_parser`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `compare_handler_sink.cmp_bytes=7` and `compare_handler_sink.stored_name_initialized_prefix_len=2`, so the sink reads past the initialized prefix.

nodes.description: The registered shortname handler record for `k` copies a 65-byte `hname` buffer even though only the first two bytes (`"k"` and its terminator) were initialized in the temporary stack record.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `supported_shortname_store.stored_name_initialized_prefix_len=2` and `supported_shortname_store.stored_name_buffer_bytes=65`.

edges.description: On the vulnerable path, the unchecked incoming `name_len` at `compare_handler` is passed unchanged as the third argument to `pj_memcmp`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `compare_handler_guard.incoming_name_len=7` and the immediately following `compare_handler_sink.cmp_bytes=7`.

edges.description: The same registered shortname entry selected at `int_register_parser` reaches `compare_handler` because its stored header-name hash remains equal to the incoming lookup hash.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `supported_shortname_store.stored_name_hash=107` and `compare_handler_guard.stored_name_hash=107`.
